mapper.sql: select distinct f.ID, IFNULL(f.FUNCTION_KEY, '') as FUNCTION_KEY, f.FUNCTION_NAME, f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT, f.FUNCTION_TYPE, f.FUNCTION_STATUS, f.REMARK, f.ANCESTORS, f.FUNCTION_LEVEL, f.VUE_PATH, f.VUE_COMPONENT, f.VUE_REDIRECT, f.VUE_NAME, f.VUE_TITLE, f.VUE_ICON, f.VUE_AFFIX, f.VUE_BADGE, r.ID as ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_KEY from SYS_FUNCTION f

select f.ID, IFNULL(f.FUNCTION_KEY, '') as FUNCTION_KEY, f.FUNCTION_NAME, f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT, f.FUNCTION_TYPE, f.FUNCTION_STATUS, f.REMARK, f.ANCESTORS, f.FUNCTION_LEVEL, f.VUE_PATH, f.VUE_COMPONENT, f.VUE_REDIRECT, f.VUE_NAME, f.VUE_TITLE, f.VUE_ICON, f.VUE_AFFIX, f.VUE_BADGE from SYS_FUNCTION f
mapper.select: select distinct f.FUNCTION_KEY from SYS_FUNCTION f left join SYS_ROLE_FUNCTION rf on f.ID = rf.FUNCTION_ID left join SYS_USER_ROLE ur on rf.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID left join SYS_ROLE r on ur.ROLE_ID = r.ID where f.FUNCTION_KEY is not null and ur.USER_ID = #{userId}
select * from SYS_FUNCTION where FIND_IN_SET(#{functionId}, ANCESTORS) <> 0
where f.FUNCTION_STATUS = '0' order by f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT

left join SYS_ROLE_FUNCTION rf on f.ID = rf.FUNCTION_ID left join SYS_USER_ROLE ur on rf.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID left join SYS_ROLE r on ur.ROLE_ID = r.ID where f.FUNCTION_TYPE = 'menu' and f.FUNCTION_STATUS = '0' order by f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT

left join SYS_ROLE_FUNCTION rf on f.ID = rf.FUNCTION_ID left join SYS_USER_ROLE ur on rf.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID left join SYS_ROLE r on ur.ROLE_ID = r.ID where ur.USER_ID = #{userId} and f.FUNCTION_TYPE = 'menu' and f.FUNCTION_STATUS = '0' order by f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT
left join SYS_ROLE_FUNCTION rf on f.ID = rf.FUNCTION_ID where rf.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} and f.FUNCTION_STATUS = '0' order by f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT

left join SYS_ROLE_FUNCTION rf on f.ID = rf.FUNCTION_ID where rf.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} and f.FUNCTION_STATUS = '0' and ( SELECT count( * ) FROM SYS_FUNCTION ff WHERE FIND_IN_SET ( f.ID, ANCESTORS ) <> 0 ) = 0 order by f.PARENT_ID, f.FUNCTION_SORT
